biod: add workaround for large MCU requests When issuing a host command whose request packet length is equal to the maximum size (ie max_request_packet_size as returned by EC_CMD_GET_PROTOCOL_INFO), the command currently fails with STM32H7 over SPI host protocol. The finger template upload through the EC_CMD_FP_TEMPLATE host command fails due to the issue as it 'optimizes' the chunk length to the maximum size. Workaround this issue by removing a 32-bit word (aka 4 bytes) to max_request_packet_size, so we never hit this corner case. BUG=b:78544921 TEST=On Meowth, restart biod with enrolled fingers and see in the log that the templates are correctly uploaded to the MCU. video_PlaybackPerf: Add audio to VP8 4k test video The VP8 4k video test doesn't have audio. It is different from the test videos for H264 and VP9 4k tests. Chrome, as of today, doesn't proceed seeking if a display is run out of and a playing video doens't have audio in video only page (i.e. when opening a video with chrome). In other words, display is hitched. It shouldn't affect the number of dropped frames, but this test would test end-to-end playback and the behavior looks strange and misunderstandable. This changes the test video as one with audio. Other things but audio (e.g. bitrate and fps) is unchanged. init: Fix _lsofFn_filter's sed script. 'x' was to pull the buffer *and* set the current line to the buffer. Hence, for instance, if the output of lsof was ------ p123 n/foo n/bar ------ it was transformed to ------ 123 n/foo ------ because 'x' while processing n/foo replaces the buffer p123 with n/foo. The new implementation using 'g' (that just pulls the buffer data) will yield ------ 123 123 ------ which works fine.
